title: Girl explorer
author: EvgeshQa
intendedUse: Active first-person player body and height reference in the tomb.

originalInspection.status: Original retained locally without modification. Source export has detached/skewed parts caused by inconsistent body bind scale.

integration.physics: Existing player collider and movement retained; model is a visual body reference.
integration.camera: Fixed first-person eye position; native body animation does not bob the camera.
integration.clothingAdaptation: Source shirt and pouch retained. Detached accessory/clothing meshes omitted; brown vertex colors approximate shorts and boots on the coherent body mesh.
integration.crouch: No source crouch clip; body reference lowers/compresses with the existing crouch height.
modifications: Corrected shared head bind-scale on body vertices
Retained body, shirt and pouch; excluded head, hair and damaged accessories
Retained native idle, walk, run and jump clips; removed attack and unused rig nodes

runtimePresentation: 2026-11-23: first-person body and clothing baked together from the authored idle pose at load; fixed reference pose follows physical feet. Native clips preserved but not played in first person. No vertical squash for crouch.
